file.title: File
file.description: The Data Map's file that holds the tables: source.json or destination.json.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: How the Data Map's table differs, or what the table added holds.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Why the table can't be copied into the Data Map (a column with no type in its database), or empty.

uncommitted.title: Uncommitted
uncommitted.description: The file has changes that aren't committed; an update joins them, uncommitted.

links.title: Links
links.description: Each linked Data Map that saving would leave behind. Empty when none would.

400.description: Not a Database node, or not a database schema

404.description: Project, workflow, or node not found
